title: Facet
description: The governance facets an asset can be selected by (FR-2A). One vocabulary used identically by asset selectors, column selectors and expressions, so a policy author learns it once.

facetOperator.description: contains walks descendants ('PII' matches 'PII.Sensitive', 'Finance' matches 'Finance.Risk.Credit'); eq matches that level only; startsWith is a segment-aware prefix. The distinction is deliberate: a broad policy survives a steward adding a tag, a narrow one does not, and both are legitimate intents.

property.description: Custom property name; required when facet is customProperty. Typed from custom_property_def so the builder shows the right editor (FR-1.9).

includeSuggested.description: OpenMetadata tag labels carry state Suggested|Confirmed. Enforcing on Suggested lets an ML guess lock data with nobody approving it, so it is opt-in per condition (FR-1.3a).

includePropagated.description: Accept labelType Propagated/Derived from OpenMetadata. Off by default: we compute inheritance ourselves and would otherwise count it twice.

assetSelector.description: A boolean tree over facet conditions. Named and/or/not rather than allOf/anyOf/not so the JSON Schema keywords stay free to validate this document itself.
